scientific_visual_finding.verbatim_original_section: Foerste 1916 **Plate IV, figures 4–5**, not Plate VI, is the relevant original fossil illustration. The coordinator handoff typo was corrected; the fixed model references were already correct. Comarocystites plates are not substituted. The actual Field Museum P5173 exterior and Treatise figure were inspected. The acorn-ovoid theca, 4 basal / 6 infralateral / 8 lateral plates, roofed tegmen, three groups with the selected 5/5/4 terminal configuration, double-biserial main-axis plate volumes, short paired lateral brachioles and posterior anal pyramid are present. Foerste's selected 14-axis example is not represented as a universal count. Paul 2021's primary schematic supports the large aboral and smaller adoral rows; exact living posture and colors remain interpretive. The exact-specimen external plate ornament is not invented as an unprovided numerical acceptance gate.

scientific_visual_finding.verbatim_original_section:
The 2025 Bohatý et al. primary paper supersedes the earlier no-anal-sac planning interpretation **before** the original freeze. Its actual Fig. 3 crown sections and Fig. 4 brachial/pinnule photographs were inspected, with juvenile/other-species panels excluded. The 2009/thesis holotype lithograph is explicitly idealized and mirrored, not a photograph; pathological cup examples were not treated as normal. The correct contemporary genus assignments were retained.

Five unbranched arms, 21 real W/omega brachials per arm (meeting the primary minimum of 20), five basals, five radials, the fused pedestal, 200 four-segment pinnules and the off-center CD-interray anal sac are present. The first brachial is nonpinnulate and low/wide. Direct measurement gives about 2.357 mm axial height and 7.517 mm cross-sectional chord; the next has essentially the same height and 7.277 mm chord. The primary text says low and wide, not an explicit first-versus-second size ratio. Therefore no arbitrary comparative-size threshold is imposed. Distal sac extent and partly unrolled living pinnules remain reconstruction choices. The buried columnal is a local frozen readability failure, not a rejection of the corrected 2025 anatomy.

scientific_visual_finding.verbatim_original_section: Regnell 1945 Plate 8.3, RM Ec3304, supplies the four visible oral facets. The complete external test and smooth epithek were distinguished from internal molds; the latter's projections were not interpreted as living spikes. The model has 313 separate mosaic plates over a nearly spherical test, four selected oral bases and eight interpreted branch tips with physical paired plates. The five-valved nominate anal pyramid is high posterior, with the small gonopore above/right. Bockelie's genus-level branching evidence supports branching, not an exact preserved whole-crown census. The four-to-eight reconstruction and slit detail remain explicitly inferred. The original circular mouth defect was corrected before this final geometry.

scientific_visual_finding.verbatim_original_section:
Rose & Cross 1993 Fig. 1 supplies the actual fossil's four views, while Fig. 3 supports associated fossil spine presence at genus level. Fig. 2 is a modern comparison and was not used as fossil soft-part proof. Stokes 1977's actual diagnosis page was read from the page image; the local text extraction is empty and is not claimed as usable text evidence. The full heart-shaped test, unequal anterior ambulacrum plus four paired petals, deep anterior notch, anterior ventral peristome behind the labrum, high posterior periproct and lower subanal fasciole match the frozen morphology. The 180 short spines/tubercles and sixteen tube feet are explicitly sampled living reconstruction, not fossil-preserved exact-species density or orientation.

Primary online checks: [Bohatý et al. 2025, author-uploaded paper, DOI 10.1127/njgpa/1274](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/394646944_First_record_of_cystidean_and_determinable_pentacrinoid_stages_in_fossil_Crinoidea_-_with_new_insights_into_the_oral_and_anal_endoskeletal_anatomy_of_the_Devonian_subfamily_Cupressocrininae_Eucladida); [Paul 2021](https://www.app.pan.pl/archive/published/app66/app008252020.html); [Bockelie 1981 abstract](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/j.1502-3931.1981.tb01689.x). The Bockelie full text was not claimed to have been read.

Micraster has peristome/periproct escape, 40 empty petal pore centers plus 16 intentionally occupied by modeled tube feet, exposed rims, actual depressed channels/notch/fasciole/spine geometry. These are original geometry and pixel findings, not a new native reexecution.

Five initial exposure misses were resolved by separate searches/precision checks, not overwritten. Old 186 coplanar overlaps (71 potentially exposed pairs) were real; fixed source fresh diagnostic has zero. Cupressocrinites terminal columnal 25 remains wholly buried and REVISE; four small internal overlap pairs are not a hardware guarantee.
